title: Can I BEAT Blindfold Hikaru?
summary: chess.com added an 'Insane' bot category containing a single bot, Blindfolded Hikaru (~2800), which you can only play blindfolded. The creator plays it with his own board showing no pieces (viewers see the game review on a second board). Game 1 (White, London System): Hikaru grabs b2 with ...Qb6xb2 and he forces a repetition (Rb1/Ra1 vs Qa2/Qb6) for a DRAW against a 2800 bot. Game 2 (Black): he plays a dry position, tries Ne4, and gets mated (Qh7/Qh8). The bot talks in Hikaru style ('arches eyebrows').
rules: Standard chess vs the 'Blindfolded Hikaru' bot.
Player must play blindfolded: all pieces of both sides are invisible on the player's board; only highlights/arrows and move dots appear.
Bot chats in-character during the game (e.g. '*arches eyebrows*').
win_condition: Checkmate the bot (draw by repetition counted as a moral victory in the video; result: 1 draw, 1 loss).
